interface.longDescription: Run and validate the local revenue-kun OSS workflow for CSV or text-based PDF rent rolls and generate an inspectable Excel workbook containing revenue estimates. OCR, scanned PDFs, photographed documents, appraisal, and investment, legal, or tax advice are outside its scope.
